scope: Internal/partner readiness only. These packages prepare lawful validation engagements and do not assert external validation, certification, qualification, adoption, or operational deployment.

OVERWATCH-ECHO.use_case: Evidence-bearing observability for synthetic, replayed, and authorized registered-source telemetry with explicit source health and provenance.
assumptions_limits: visualization never elevates evidence state
unregistered or uncalibrated sources remain synthetic/unverified
correlation is not causation
OVERWATCH-ECHO.baseline: Existing local observability/audit software and synthetic-source workflow; calibrated live-source validation remains external.
OVERWATCH-ECHO.partner_interface: A partner supplies a lawful registered source, calibration record, timing reference, ground truth where available, and permission boundary.
OVERWATCH-ECHO.external_safe_statement: OVERWATCH/ECHO provides source-governed observability and provenance controls; source accuracy and operational identification remain source- and validation-dependent.

WS-ENERGY.use_case: Technology-neutral microgrid, energy-storage, Grid-PACE, and thermal-system design validation using complete-chain accounting, degraded-state tests, digital-twin correlation, and HIL progression.
assumptions_limits: component ratings do not equal installed-system performance
source energy metrics remain technology-specific
initial work is synthetic/HIL
hazardous high-voltage/destructive tests require qualified facilities
WS-ENERGY.baseline: Worldshepherd complete mass-energy discipline plus synthetic microgrid surrogate; Sandia MDT/PyMDT is the preferred public planning baseline when executed on a compliant Windows x64 MDT installation.
acceptance: faults are detected and recoverable in bounded simulations
WS-ENERGY.partner_interface: Planning tool owner or microgrid partner supplies candidate design/model; HIL laboratory supplies real-time simulator/controller/protection interfaces; later physical test requires qualified electrical safety controls.
WS-ENERGY.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd is developing a complete-chain, fault-aware validation layer for energy and microgrid designs; current physical performance remains simulation/HIL/partner dependent.

WS-ALTI.use_case: Spatially varied multi-feed DED research with process-to-composition-to-defect-to-property provenance.
assumptions_limits: candidate phases/properties remain predicted until measured
feed command is process intent rather than local composition proof
no flight/manufacturing claim from modeling alone
WS-ALTI.baseline: Architecture, prior-art triage, composition hypotheses, process concept, validation ladder, and multi-feed digital-thread requirements exist; CALPHAD/physical evidence remains external.
WS-ALTI.partner_interface: Qualified DED facility plus materials-characterization laboratory capable of phase/composition/microstructure and mechanical/thermal testing; counsel-approved IP boundary before enabling disclosure.
WS-ALTI.external_safe_statement: WS-AlTi is a design-stage spatially varied multi-feed DED research platform with defined validation gates; material properties and manufacturability require laboratory confirmation.

WS-MS.use_case: Programmable electromagnetic boundary-condition control within a frozen band/function with simulation-to-VNA correlation.
assumptions_limits: existing 9,675-case campaigns are simulated only
reduced/analytic models require external 3-D correlation
no fabricated-array performance claim
WS-MS.baseline: Large hashed simulation campaigns with controls/nulls, convergence and failed-case retention; S11/S17-family external-solver/VNA gate remains open.
WS-MS.partner_interface: EM solver and RF laboratory capable of full-wave correlation, fabrication metrology, calibrated VNA measurement, and environmental repeatability.
WS-MS.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd has a governed simulation and validation architecture for programmable metasurfaces; Worldshepherd-specific measured RF performance remains unvalidated.

RESONANCE.use_case: Conventional structural/acoustic/fluid/EM/thermal/control resonance diagnostics and bounded research hypotheses.
assumptions_limits: no non-Newtonian or propulsion gain inferred from vibration/resonance
diagnostic transfer requires domain-specific baseline
nonconventional interpretations remain quarantined
RESONANCE.baseline: Applied Resonance test-enabler architecture exists for rotor imbalance, joints, bearings, cable/pressure-line health and structural twins; physical diagnostic benchmark remains open.
RESONANCE.partner_interface: Conventional instrumentation laboratory or equipment owner supplies a bounded article, known-fault truth, safe excitation envelope, and calibrated sensors.
RESONANCE.external_safe_statement: Applied Resonance is a test and diagnostic research program; conventional diagnostic performance requires instrumented validation and nonconventional propulsion/energy interpretations are not currently claimed.

TIDELENS.use_case: Source-governed digital engineering and sensing qualification with synthetic baseline, replay, HIL, and controlled-field progression.
assumptions_limits: synthetic data is not field validation
detection is separate from physical identification
partner hardware performance is not inherited by Worldshepherd
TIDELENS.baseline: Early software/governance and synthetic scenarios exist; recorded representative data and HIL remain external.
TIDELENS.partner_interface: Sensor/platform partner supplies lawful representative data or HIL interface; field test requires spectrum/site/safety authorization.
TIDELENS.external_safe_statement: TIDELENS provides an evidence-governed sensing and mission-assurance framework; RF hardware performance and operational qualification remain partner- and test-dependent.

AEROSHEPHERD.use_case: Aircraft digital engineering and mission-assurance integration without claiming flight-qualified autonomy or airframe performance.
assumptions_limits: synthetic fleet scenarios do not establish flight performance
retrofit feasibility is aircraft-specific
certification basis must be partner/regulator defined
AEROSHEPHERD.baseline: Early architecture and synthetic scenarios exist; physical airframe integration remains external.
AEROSHEPHERD.partner_interface: Airframe/integrator provides aircraft-specific data, certification basis, HIL/iron-bird access, structural/EMC facilities, and flight authority.
AEROSHEPHERD.external_safe_statement: AEROSHEPHERD is an evidence-governed digital-engineering and mission-assurance architecture supported by synthetic scenarios; airframe integration and flight qualification require accredited partners and testing.

HELIOS-LINK.use_case: Bounded low-power transfer/link-budget research with explicit pointing, conversion, thermal, interruption, and safety accounting.
assumptions_limits: no orbital or TRL-5 claim
external power does not erase receiver/reserve mass
simulation efficiency is not measured end-to-end efficiency
HELIOS-LINK.baseline: Synthetic transfer scenarios and bounded link-budget requirements exist; physical transfer remains external.
HELIOS-LINK.partner_interface: Qualified optical/RF power-transfer laboratory supplies source/receiver instrumentation, controlled range, safety officer, and calibrated power measurement.
HELIOS-LINK.external_safe_statement: HELIOS-LINK is an evidence-governed power-transfer architecture with synthetic scenarios and defined validation gates; physical transfer performance remains unvalidated.

BAROS.use_case: Research-stage adaptive radiotherapy optimization for expert review and retrospective validation, never direct patient care without institutional/regulatory authorization.
assumptions_limits: biological model output is not clinical outcome
no treatment recommendation
dataset and DICOM-RT use require governance
qualified medical physics review required
BAROS.baseline: Conceptual/computational manuscript and validation architecture exist; qualified domain validation remains external.
BAROS.partner_interface: Qualified radiation-oncology/medical-physics institution supplies lawful data access, validated dose environment, clinical governance, IRB/regulatory pathway where applicable.
BAROS.external_safe_statement: BAROS is a research-stage adaptive radiotherapy optimization architecture intended for expert review, retrospective validation, and controlled translational development.

LIFT-X10-X40-X400.use_case: Requirements-driven lift architecture research using complete mass-energy-range closure and staged component-to-system validation.
assumptions_limits: 10:1/40:1/400:1 and 4,000 nmi are targets until demonstrated
1,000x values are research envelopes
boundary failures are stop conditions
frontier lanes receive no vehicle credit before independent evidence
LIFT-X10-X40-X400.baseline: Extensive numerical screens, explicit conventional closure failures, candidate architectures, and evidence gates exist.
LIFT-X10-X40-X400.partner_interface: Propulsion dyno, structural/material lab, aerodynamic test capability, systems integrator, and qualified flight-test organization are required by stage.
LIFT-X10-X40-X400.external_safe_statement: The X10/X40/X400 program is a requirements and validation architecture; complete vehicle ratio/range performance is not currently claimed.

ION-EP.use_case: Conventional ion/electric-propulsion component and mission-integration research with calibrated thrust and endurance gates.
assumptions_limits: high Isp does not imply high thrust
electric propulsion is not reactionless or unassisted Earth launch
performance remains hardware-specific
ION-EP.baseline: Architecture-level integration requirements and conventional physics boundaries are defined; specific component/plasma baseline remains to be selected.
ION-EP.partner_interface: Vacuum/plasma propulsion laboratory with calibrated thrust balance, high-voltage safety, plume diagnostics, and endurance capability.
ION-EP.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd may model electric-propulsion mission integration, but no propulsion performance is claimed without registered hardware and calibrated test evidence.

WS-LAB-BOONE.use_case: Lawful inventory-first assessment of potential laboratory/equipment reuse; experiments are selected only after equipment identity/capability is verified.
assumptions_limits: no equipment existence/ownership/capability is assumed
no experiment is reverse-engineered around an unverified instrument
WS-LAB-BOONE.baseline: Planning and lawful inventory workflow exist; actual equipment identity and disposition evidence are not yet established.
WS-LAB-BOONE.partner_interface: The actual owner/custodian and qualified facility personnel must be identified from primary records before technical use planning can close.
WS-LAB-BOONE.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd can structure an evidence-controlled equipment-reuse assessment after lawful inventory, capability, safety, and ownership verification.

STEG.use_case: Reproducible digital-media triage for metadata, format, channel, byte-level and embedded-payload hypotheses.
assumptions_limits: digital RGB values are not calibrated physical spectra
patterns require false-positive controls
payload claims require reproducible extraction
STEG.baseline: Extensive triage rules and tooling requirements exist; one consolidated scanner and fixture corpus remain open.
STEG.partner_interface: No external facility is required for baseline software validation; independent forensic review is useful for higher-confidence claims.
STEG.external_safe_statement: Stegriage is a structured digital-media triage method; it does not convert ordinary images into physical spectroscopy without calibrated acquisition data.

MEISSNER-COLLAB.use_case: IP-minimized candidate-to-device evidence/provenance and multiobjective optimization layer around superconducting-material discovery and SNSPD validation.
assumptions_limits: no proprietary composition required for initial pilot
no claim that Worldshepherd predicts superconductors
no public material-performance claim until measured
company engagement is not partnership
hazards: cryogenic/electrical laboratory hazards at partner site
MEISSNER-COLLAB.baseline: Collaboration architecture, one-page pilot, IP-minimized schema concept, claims boundary, and initial outreach are complete; no Meissner dataset or substantive engagement is assumed.
MEISSNER-COLLAB.partner_interface: Meissner or another authorized materials partner supplies opaque candidate/device records and determines IP boundaries; qualified fabrication/characterization facility supplies measured data.
MEISSNER-COLLAB.external_safe_statement: Worldshepherd proposes an evidence/provenance and application-optimization layer around superconducting-material validation; material and device performance remain partner- and experiment-dependent.
